metrics.touched: ground-truth signal appears anywhere in the report
metrics.confirmed: ground-truth signal appears in a confirmed evidence section
metrics.false_positive_rate: confirmed claims without matching evidence, supplied by an external evaluator
metrics.time_to_first_verified_foothold: wall-clock seconds from session start to a verified session

comparison_policy: Do not claim superiority over another project unless the same lab image, scope, budget, model class, and scoring protocol are independently reproduced.
